cat > /home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs/task-dd9cb1b3.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Expand each interior seed into its matching border color sequence."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    templates = []
    for row_idx in (0, h - 1):
        row = grid[row_idx]
        i = 0
        while i < w:
            if row[i] == 0:
                i += 1
                continue
            seq = []
            while i < w and row[i] != 0:
                seq.append(row[i])
                i += 1
            templates.append(seq)
    out = [r[:] for r in grid]
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c, color in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if color == 0:
                continue
            candidates = [seq for seq in templates if color in seq]
            if not candidates:
                continue
            seq = candidates[0]
            start = c - seq.index(color)
            for k, value in enumerate(seq):
                cc = start + k
                if 0 <= cc < w:
                    out[r][cc] = value
    return out
PY

source='''def transform(grid):
    """Expand each interior seed into its matching border color sequence."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    templates = []
    for row_idx in (0, h - 1):
        row = grid[row_idx]
        i = 0
        while i < w:
            if row[i] == 0:
                i += 1
                continue
            seq = []
            while i < w and row[i] != 0:
                seq.append(row[i])
                i += 1
            templates.append(seq)
    out = [r[:] for r in grid]
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c, color in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if color == 0:
                continue
            candidates = [seq for seq in templates if color in seq]
            if not candidates:
                continue
            seq = candidates[0]
            start = c - seq.index(color)
            for k, value in enumerate(seq):
                cc = start + k
                if 0 <= cc < w:
                    out[r][cc] = value
    return out
'''
